swimming_pool.evidence: Bright turquoise rectangular pool with a rounded end sits just east of the central house, surrounded by a light patio.

detached_structure.evidence: A small structure or pergola-like feature with dark roofing sits at the north end of the pool deck, and a lattice or pergola section is attached to the west side of the house. It is unclear whether either is truly detached.
detached_structure.detail: Possible pool house or pergola near the pool

signals.notes: The house has a multi-gabled gray roof, a curved walkway, and a paved driveway running south to the street. There is a prominent in-ground pool at the rear and a large lawn to the west, with dense mature trees to the north and east.
